name: bands/rolling_stats
description: A rolling mean and a mean ± 2σ BandSeries over 10,000 samples of a simulated vibration sensor. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore tabs, headings, descriptions, switches, and the cursor readout.

checks.expectation: One plot fills most of the page. The X axis is titled 'Time (s)' and spans 0 to 600; the Y axis is titled 'Acceleration (g)' and spans about -2.5 to 4. A legend in the top-right corner lists 'Samples', 'Mean ± 2σ', and 'Rolling mean'.
A solid orange line runs across the full width of the plot, following a smooth wave between about -1 and 1.2 g.

A translucent orange-brown band surrounds the orange line along its whole length. It is narrow for most of the time, and clearly widens in two places: a large bulge around 150 to 200 s that reaches down to about -2 g, and a smaller one around 460 to 480 s. The line stays inside the band everywhere.

Within the plot, axis titles, tick labels, and legend text are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, tabs, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
The plot is not blank, corrupted, or drawn outside its plot area. The band has continuous edges without spikes, holes, or stray triangles.
